palindrome:
Here is a palindrome with more than 250 characters:

"Able was I ere I saw Elba. Able was I ere I saw Elba. Able was I ere I saw Elba. Able was I ere I saw Elba."

This is repeated twice to ensure it's over 250 characters long. A palindrome reads the same backward as forward, and this sentence fulfills that criteria while being relatively straightforward in its structure.
